title: Processing five open returns at Lumen Home & Tech

steps.title: Open RMA-1041 and check the reason
steps.decision: Defect, inside the window, normal customer: replacement first

reason.text: Headphones, one ear died after a week, ordered eleven days ago. That is a plain defect, so I send a replacement first.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

steps.title: RMA-1042: damaged lamp, carrier claim
steps.decision: Crushed box, shattered shade: Carrier claim, not a refund

reason.text: See the crushed box and the customer photo? That happened on the truck, so it is a carrier claim. We never pay that out of our own pocket.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

steps.title: RMA-1043: refund with restocking fee, escalate
steps.decision: Refund minus the 15 % fee, then escalate to a supervisor

reason.text: It is opened and he just changed his mind, so the 15 % restocking fee applies. And over two hundred euros I never complete myself, that goes to a supervisor.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

steps.title: RMA-1044: possible abuse
steps.decision: Escalate as possible abuse instead of refunding

reason.text: Nine returns out of ten orders. I do not refund that, I escalate it as possible abuse.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

steps.title: RMA-1045: goodwill refund for a loyal customer
steps.decision: Goodwill refund of 45.00, outside the window

reason.text: She has been with us since 2017, 41 orders and not one return. Four days late on a kettle, I give her the goodwill refund.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

guardrails.statement: Damaged in transit is a carrier claim, never a refund or replacement from our own pocket.

reason.text: Damaged in transit is the carrier's problem. I never refund or replace that from our own pocket, I file a carrier claim.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

guardrails.statement: Any return over 200 EUR goes to a supervisor; never complete it yourself.

reason.text: Anything over two hundred euros goes to a supervisor. I never complete those myself.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

guardrails.statement: A customer who returned most of their orders is not refunded; escalate as possible abuse.

reason.text: When someone has sent back most of what they ordered, I do not refund. I escalate it as possible abuse.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt

guardrails.statement: Opened electronics returned for 'changed my mind' get a 15 % restocking fee; defects never do.

reason.text: If it is opened and they just changed their mind, 15 % restocking fee. A defect never gets a fee.
reason.speaker: M. Brandt
